assertions.source: Pochhammer bridge hab_A/hab_B > 1 for both species

description: Deuteron Habiro correction tower at H_6 (n=6, p(6)=11). The proton normalization tr_M*Plancherel*Vol/h^2 gives S_p=1.00949 ~ 1, but S_d=371.752 >> 1. The (1+h^2)(1-h^2/p(n)) tower is proton-specific at this normalization. Pochhammer bridge ratio present for both species (proton: 5.61649, deuteron: 27.2342), but A-dependent normalization needed to bring deuteron near 1.

data.universality_result: NEGATIVE: (1+h^2)(1-h^2/p(n)) tower is proton-specific at tr_M*Plancherel*Vol/h^2 normalization. Deuteron S >> 1.
